artworks.title: Joseph Slade
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a side-profile position. He has light blue eyes, a long nose, thin lips, and dark brown, wavy hair with sideburns. He wears a dark coat, a white high-collared shirt, and a white cravat. The man rests his arm on the back of a wooden chair and holds a closed book. The background is a neutral-toned canvas.

artworks.title: Alsa Slade
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up, seated and holding a piece of lacework. She faces slightly to her right, with a direct gaze. Her facial features include deep-set eyes, a pronounced nose, and slightly pursed lips. She wears a white cap with lace edges and an olive-green dress with long sleeves. A white shawl drapes over her dress and is tied into a bow at the front. She wears a string of pearls around her neck. Beside her is a table with a decorative cloth featuring floral motifs. The background is a plain, muted tone.

artworks.title: Hannah Fisher Stedman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a seated woman. She is sitting upright with her arms relaxed, holding a small red book. Her facial features are detailed, with a fair complexion, high cheekbones, and a slightly serious expression. Her dark hair is styled in an elaborate updo with a floral embellishment. The woman wears a formal, high-necked brown dress with voluminous sleeves, and a transparent lace-like cape draped over her shoulders. She has a long, black beaded necklace layered with a shorter one. The background is a muted, earthy tone with texture.

artworks.title: John Stone
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a half-body portrait. He is seated, facing forward, with his torso and hands visible. His left arm rests on a surface. The man has angular features, light-colored eyes, brown hair styled to the side, and wears formal attire. He holds a book in his left hand. The background has a textured gradient with a pillar on the right and abstract greenery on the left.

artworks.title: Eliza Welch Stone
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a painted portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is seated and facing directly towards the viewer with her right arm resting on a surface, holding a white vase containing pink and orange flowers. Her facial features include large, light-colored eyes, a straight nose, and a closed mouth, with tightly curled, brown hair falling over her shoulders. She is wearing a dark, long-sleeved dress with a white lace collar and a brooch. On her lap, there is a colorful patterned fabric with hints of yellow, blue, and orange. She wears a ring on her right hand. The background consists of a wall with an ornate, red curtain draped to her right and a detailed blue pattern behind her.

artworks.title: Charles Adams Wheeler
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a young person with fair skin, wide eyes, and straight hair falling past the shoulders. They are wearing a formal outfit consisting of a red coat over a dark waistcoat with rounded buttons, white cuffs, and a white collar. The person holds a hat in their left hand and a stack of red books under their left arm, with their right arm resting against their side. In the background, there is a plain, muted color with a green drape with tassels visible to the right of the subject.

artworks.title: Baby in Blue
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: The Strawberry Girl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: A young, pale-skinned girl sits on a wooden chair in this vertical portrait painting. Her body is angled to our right so her feet are cut off by the bottom right corner of the canvas. She has round cheeks, green eyes, a dainty mouth, and a cleft chin. A ruffled white bonnet tied around the crown with a carnation-pink bow covers her hair. Her white dress has short, flutter sleeves, a straight neckline across the chest, and a high waist. The gossamer-white skirt falls to her feet and has decorative bands near the hem. A cherry-red sash is tied around her waist and falls over the back of the chair. The girl holds a bunch of red strawberries in one hand and holds one up by her chest with the other. The background is dark bronze brown.

artworks.title: Boy in Blue
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a young child standing upright. The child has short light brown hair and is looking slightly to the side with a neutral expression and rosy cheeks. The child is wearing a blue outfit with decorative gold buttons down the front, a large white ruffled collar, and matching gold tassel detail on the waist. In their right hand, they hold a red book with a yellow edge. Their black shoes are visible, positioned on a decorative floor that features a floral pattern with green and black geometric shapes and yellow floral accents. The background is a plain brown.

artworks.title: Brother and Sister
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a young girl in a full-body portrait. The man is seated on a white bench, while the girl stands beside him with her hand on his shoulder. Both have fair skin and brown hair. The man wears a black suit with a white shirt, a black tie, and a patterned vest. The girl wears a blue dress with white lace trim and a white petticoat. A straw hat and a book are near the man, and a small brown dog and a white bonnet with blue ribbons are on the grass. Lush green trees and a body of water are in the background.

artworks.title: Little Miss Wyckoff
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Feeding the Bird
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Little Girl with Flower Basket
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Little Girl with Doll
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a young individual facing slightly left. The individual has short light brown hair, dark eyes, a small nose, and closed mouth. They wear a red dress with white lace trim, and a red beaded necklace. They hold a small dark-haired doll in a blue gown with white lace. The background is dark.

artworks.title: Little Girl with Slate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a young child seated on a carved wooden chair, facing forward with legs hanging over the edge. The child holds a small chalkboard with writing on it and has light blonde hair, big blue eyes, wearing a white dress with red trim, white pants, and brown lace-up boots. There is a red necklace around their neck and a dark brown background with a red curtain partly visible.

artworks.title: Boy with Toy Horse and Wagon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a young child standing upright. The child has light-colored, short hair, a pale complexion, and delicate features. They are dressed in a dark garment with a dotted pattern and light edges, light-colored pantaloons, patterned socks, and dark shoes with bows. In their right hand, the child holds a stick with a string attached, and in their left hand, they hold a string connected to a small colorful toy horse pulling a cart. The backdrop consists of red curtains on the sides, against a wooden floor and wall.

artworks.title: Blue Eyes
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the head and shoulders of a person, positioned in profile, facing to the right. The person has light skin, blue eyes, subtly pursed lips, and dark brown hair styled in a bob. They are wearing a dark green garment with a white collar and a red bow. The background is solid brown.

artworks.title: Little Girl with Pet Rabbit
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a young child shown from the waist up. The child is seated and facing forward. The child has dark hair that is styled smoothly and parted down the middle. The facial features include wide, dark eyes and a small, full-lipped mouth. The child is wearing a dress with a wide neckline and puffed sleeves, which is coral in color with delicate white lace trim. Around the child's neck is a simple gold chain necklace. The child holds a white rabbit with a black spot on its back in their right arm. The background is a plain, dark gray color.

artworks.title: Girl with Toy Rooster
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a young child standing upright, facing forward. The child has light skin, light brown hair, light blue eyes, and a neutral expression. They are dressed in a long, gray dress with a red lower part, red socks, and brown shoes with green bows. The child is holding a small model of a rooster. Next to them, on the floor, is a box with small objects like a doll and a ball. The background is a simple greenish-brown gradient.

artworks.title: Little Girl in Blue Dress
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a young girl, seated with her torso facing the viewer. She has fair skin, light blue eyes, thin eyebrows, and slightly rosy cheeks. Her reddish-brown hair is styled neatly with a middle part, and she is wearing a dark blue off-the-shoulder dress with decorative trim. She is holding a small flower with green leaves in her hand. The background is a solid dark color.

artworks.title: Lady Wearing Pearls
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: The Blue Shawl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting on a wooden chair with a decorative backrest. The individual is facing slightly to the right, making eye contact with the viewer. They have fair skin, blue eyes, reddish lips, and dark curly hair styled with a wave, partially covered by a brown fez-like hat. The person is wearing a dark green garment underneath a light blue fringed shawl. The background is a plain, muted brown color.

artworks.title: At the Writing Table
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting depicts a person seated at a wooden table. Their torso and arms are visible as they lean forward, with one arm resting on a piece of paper and the other dipping a feather quill into an inkwell. The person has pale skin, a long nose, arched eyebrows, small red lips, and short dark hair. They are wearing a blue coat over a light-colored shirt with thin, vertical red-and-black stripes. Also on the wooden table are a small knife and a large brown book with a black top hat resting on it. In front of the table, a small boy and a girl are playing on the patterned floor. They are each holding the ends of a long string that has a white bird perched on it. Both children have pale skin and brown hair, and the boy on the left wears a blue coat and trousers while the girl on the right wears a red dress. The background is a light blue wall with a window on the left side. The wall and floor seem to be slightly curved.  Elaborate orange-and-pink decorative scrollwork frames the scene along the top and sides against a black background.

artworks.title: Old Man in Red Slat Back Chair
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting in a chair. He has fair skin, light brown hair, and is wearing formal attire. He is gazing directly at the viewer. The man is holding an open book in his left hand, while his right arm rests on the chair's arm. The background is plain and brown, drawing attention to the man.
